data.text:
Jayantilal vs Shri Sanjeev Kumar Mishra Food Safety ... on 11 
March, 2024 
Author: Anil Verma
Bench: Anil Verma
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Sa No. 652 of 2021 (Jayantilal
And Others Vs Shri Sanjeev Kumar Mishra Food Safety Officer) Dated :
11-03-2024 None for appellant.
Shri Shalabh Sharma Government Advocate for State.  As directed earlier by this court matter was kept before Hon'ble Chief Justice for appropriate orders for amendment in the High Court Rules. 
But till now it appears that no order has been received. 
Registry is directed to enquire and list the matter after eight weeks. 
(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE BDJ Jayantilal vs Shri Sanjeev Kumar Mishra Food Safety ... on 11 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121821867/
